title: Offer builder with inline spec
spec: Add src/payer/offer.ts: buildOffer({ signer, amount, asset = "PAPER", rails = ["paper"], spec, taskId, claimMin = 30, refundMin = 60, expireMin = 10, nowMs }) → { offer, specNote: { ns, key, value } }. The spec note lives at ns tclk-job-<last 2 chars of taskId, non-alnum → 0>, key = taskId stripped to [a-z0-9_-] and cut to 14. job = { proto: "flop-harness", id: taskId, context: <spec cut to 300 chars> + " | full spec: /kv/<ns>/<key>" } because the biggest outside worker cluster reads job.context as the task itself. Use makeOffer for the frame.
done: For the fixture inputs the offer validates with tclk and the context and note address equal the expected strings.
